notes.title: WW2 Rebuilder: Germany Prologue | Major Game Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Builders!

Our game's full release is coming and we prepared something special for you guys!

Now, you can play WW2 Rebuilder: Germany Prologue  with a Patch 1.1. 

We prepared the prologue for you in its final state. We worked on some features, we made sure that the game is fully playable and we have our testers' green light. 

List of changes:


 We added a shovel tool, which allows you to pick up a lot of debris or raw materials at once and way easier.
 We added a special audio collectible to find - if you played Germany Prologue once, it might be a great new objective for you.
 We made some changes to in-game cutscenes.
 Our workshop's look has improved, it's categorized better now
  We also added new decorations and props for you to play with. 
 We improved overall performance in our game - as we know, you did report to us FPS drops, so we worked on that.
 We fixed physics, so no more weird blocks of bricks floating in the air!
 We fixed bugs and crashes you reported to us and the ones we found ourselves.
 Do you enjoy playing WW2 Rebuilder on controller? We improved playing the that way

Add full version of WW2 Rebuilder to your Wishlist!
Release date - 16.01.2023!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573280/WW2_Rebuilder/

notes.title: It's not a drill! 16.01.2023 | WW2 Rebuilder release
notes.notes:
Hi Builders!

We know you've been waiting for a while now, but today - just before winter holidays! - we come with a present!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41990769/97bccc2d6e17b79bb3a2dc968997bea735f906ba.png

Testers are giving us a green light and we believe that WW2 Rebuilder is ready to see the light of day!
We are excited and scared but mostly happy to finally tell you that on 16th of January 2023 you'll play our game!

The game is ready. We decided to get rid of the Early Access label, as we managed to finish it. The maps you will get access to with the full version: 

 a tutorial on a farm in Bibury 
 Gimbert railroad station
 Necropolis railroad station in London
 London (part of the city)
 RAF Lympne military airfield
 Belfast shipyard (from which the Titanic once sailed)
 Essen arms factory
 Hamburg (the area around St. Nicholas Church)
 the coast at Dunkirk
 map in free build mode (Wrocław - SANDBOX)

We will still bring you 2 more maps later on, Normandy and Ludendorff. If the game's successful we will continue working on WW2 Rebuilder even further. 

We thank you for being so supportive of us. We couldn't have done it without you and all the positive messages we've got from you were keeping us going.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41990769/9ee3209fe0b5518fd52d57e7da10f63cca3e4d52.png

***

BUT! There is more news today that we want to share. We want to be transparent with you and let you know our plans right now, as a studio. For more info on that check out our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40090453/0816c1252872ba008f0444ff21b3b75c13ff9106.png

Till next time!

Builders!

31.08.2022 is the official date! This is not a drill!

Our WW2 Rebuilder - full version of the game - is going to be released one day before the 83rd anniversary of the start of the biggest military conflict in world history - World War II. 

We are so excited to share our work with you very soon. We are overwhelmed by how well-received was WW2 Rebuilder: Germany Prologue. But we are taking notes of all your feedback - good and bad - and working hard on providing you the best possible experience with the full version. Thanks to you all of it is even possible.
